notes:
Short CRM notes — messy/compressed:
- Primary contact: Raj Kapoor (Dir Eng) -> champion. Legal: Priya Shah. Procurement: Tom Li.
- Use-case: fraud scoring + in-product chat assistant for traders; latency target ~ <100ms p95, throughput ~ 250 qps during peak. Cost sensitivity: medium-high.
- Security ask: Embercrest requires vendor SOC2 Type II (full report) + ISO27001 certificate + KMS attestation + quarterly penetration test results. They explicitly said 'no redactions unless accompanied by auditor letter and network diagrams'.
- Redwood response: provided redacted SOC2 Type II + ISO cert + SOC auditor contact info; offered dedicated VPC and private deployment options. Legal escalated to security team for review on 10/18.
- Compliance outcome: Embercrest legal declined redacted artifacts citing internal policy; they required full SOC2 report escrow or on-site audit access. Redwood policy prevents sharing unredacted reports and on-site audit for hosted accounts.
- Competitor dynamics: MegaCloudAI offered a signed statement + completed attestation and promised reserved/dedicated hosts and an auditor attestation that satisfied Embercrest. Procurement favored competitor.
- Other issues: late Oct — budget freeze + Raj left (no champion).
- Quote from Priya Shah (Embercrest legal): "We can't accept hosted logs or summaries — we need full attestations or an on-site audit statement. Redactions don't give us assurance."
- Next steps: AE recommends close-lost; capture redaction-policy blocker for security playbook, and follow up in 6 months if hiring/champion returns or if Redwood changes sharing policy.
- Links: demo ff_2024-09-20-embercrest-demo, drive/pricing deck, sec faq.
- Internal: SE notes that dedicated/private deployment could have moved deal earlier if SOC2 attestation timeline accelerated; recommend playbook: expedite enterprise audit attestation or sales collateral about third-party auditor contact.
